title: Audit an Amazon ASIN
prompt: Run a complete AI shopping visibility audit for this Amazon ASIN or URL. Lock the exact variant, cite every product fact, and give me the highest-value source-backed listing fixes.

title: Audit from a source packet
prompt: Audit the attached product source packet for AI shopping visibility. Clearly label the run as source-packet-only and identify any recommendations blocked by missing live listing evidence.

title: Find unanswered buyer questions
prompt: Generate and score the natural-language buyer questions this Amazon listing should answer, then prioritize the gaps most likely to affect purchase confidence or returns.
